_note: Flywheel loop/route binding table (DESIGN.md §13 法定配置). Bindings live here, never in skills. All models run reasoning_effort/thinking=max (§7): pi via --thinking max; kimi CLI via per-invocation env KIMI_MODEL_THINKING_EFFORT=max (never touches the user's global config). v0.19: NO fallback providers — every role runs on exactly one subscription channel; QUOTA/RATE_LIMIT degrades to same-channel backoff retries (RATE_LIMIT) or direct inbox escalation (QUOTA).

judge._note: milestone final verification primary, FRESH context each call (headless -p spawns never resume); kimi -p enforces auto permission by default (explicit --auto conflicts with --prompt)

hard._note: escalation route after repeated GLM-5.3-flash failures; cross-vendor vs K3-family failure modes (§11.6)

judge-panel._note: v0.18 A3 dual-judge panel (TOP-LEVEL key, sibling of loops): second opinion on the milestone final verification — judge primary runs kimi code + K3 (loops.judge), panel secondary is GLM-5.3 cross-vendor; agreement decides, split escalates to inbox (DESIGN §4.3). Delete this key to disable the panel.

zai-coding-plan._note: 智谱 GLM Coding Plan subscription, sole non-Kimi channel since v0.21 (OpenCode Go removed; no fallback provider): RATE_LIMIT degrades to same-channel backoff retries, QUOTA escalates to inbox. Model family: glm-5.3 / glm-5.3-flash; auth via ZAI_API_KEY env (endpoint/provider wiring lives user-side in omp config).

kimi-subscription._note: kimi code CLI subscription login (device-code OAuth), no API key injected; sole Kimi-side channel since v0.19 (Plan/Garden/Judge-primary/frontend/hard all ride it)

_note_pricing: USD per 1M tokens, fallback when the driver reports no cost. pi reports usage.cost itself. glm-5.3-flash: placeholder zeros — no official token pricing published yet (AA $0.045/task is not equivalent); backfill from first real spawn's usage.cost.
